edges.reason: initialize writes the base token URI string state variable.
initialize sets _reserved to 100.
initialize sets _price to 0.02 ether.
initialize assigns the payout address w1.
initialize calls _safeMint(w1, 0) during construction.
pause sets the _paused flag through _pause.
unpause clears the _paused flag through _unpause.
onlyOwner on pause compares owner() against msg.sender.
onlyOwner on unpause compares owner() against msg.sender.
_authorizeUpgrade is guarded by onlyOwner reading _owner.
setBaseURI is restricted to the owner slot.
setPrice is restricted to the owner slot.
setReserved is restricted to the owner slot.
withdrawAll is restricted to the owner slot.
setBaseURI overwrites _baseTokenURI with the supplied string.
setPrice overwrites the mint price state variable.
setReserved overwrites the reserved count state variable.
getPrice returns the stored _price value.
getReserved returns the stored _reserved value.
adopt uses the caller-controlled msg.sender as the mint recipient without further authorization.
adopt reads _price to compute the required payment.
adopt reads _reserved when enforcing the maximum supply.
adopt computes new token ids as supply + i inside the mint loop.
adopt computes _price * num for the msg.value requirement.
adopt calls _safeMint for every requested token.
_safeMint triggers an external onERC721Received callback on contract recipients before state is fully settled.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which performs the external receiver call.
whenNotPaused on _beforeTokenTransfer reads the _paused state variable.
giveAway reads _reserved to bound the amount distributed.
giveAway decrements the _reserved storage counter by _amount.
giveAway safe-mints reserved tokens in a loop.
withdrawAll sends the balance to the hard-coded address w1.
withdrawAll performs a low-level send of the entire balance to w1, an external call.
upgradeTo relies on _authorizeUpgrade to gate the upgrade.
upgradeTo reaches the delegatecall path with a caller-supplied implementation.
adopt consumes the num parameter for all its bound checks.
num is multiplied by _price in the payment check.
num drives the supply + i token id arithmetic in the mint loop.
the cached totalSupply value is added to the loop index to derive token ids.
the cached supply seeds the token ids passed to _safeMint.
the loop index participates in the token id passed to _safeMint.
setBaseURI receives the baseURI parameter.
the baseURI parameter is written into the _baseTokenURI state variable.
setPrice receives the _newPrice parameter.
the _newPrice parameter is written into the _price state variable.
setReserved receives the _newReserved parameter.
the _newReserved parameter is written into the _reserved state variable.
giveAway receives the recipient parameter _to.
the recipient _to is forwarded to _safeMint.
giveAway receives the _amount parameter controlling the mint loop length.
_amount is subtracted from the _reserved storage counter.
walletOfOwner receives the _owner address to enumerate.
balanceOf(_owner) produces the tokenCount local used to size the array.
_authorizeUpgrade receives the newImplementation address.
the caller-supplied implementation address flows into the delegatecall target.
the cached supply in giveAway seeds token ids passed to _safeMint.
the cached supply feeds the arithmetic used alongside the reserved decrement loop.

normalization_plan.reason: The num parameter has no independent semantic role outside adopt; fold it into the adopt function node.
The baseURI parameter is only meaningful as the input of setBaseURI.
The _newPrice parameter exists solely as the setPrice argument.
The _newReserved parameter is only used by setReserved.
The _to recipient parameter is scoped entirely to giveAway.
The _amount parameter drives the giveAway loop and reserved decrement, so it merges into giveAway.
The _owner parameter is only the query input of walletOfOwner.
The newImplementation argument is consumed by the upgrade authorization path and folds into _authorizeUpgrade.
The cached supply local is only used to compute supply + i, so it merges into the arithmetic operation.
The cached supply in giveAway feeds the reserved/supply arithmetic and merges into that operation.
tokenCount is a transient loop bound inside walletOfOwner and merges into that function.
The adopt loop index is only used to build the tokenId passed to _safeMint, so it merges into _safeMint.
